selection.eligibility: unique uid; ZIP program byte-identical to JSONL output; prefix boundary ok; no EOS inside output; n_prefix_tokens <= 250; n_response_tokens <= 700 (EOS included)
selection.offset_range: 1..31, same rng instance after the query draw, same offsets for all queries
selection.reference_eligible_pool: 4949/5513 (89.77%), Codex read-only pre-count from the P0 coverage table; independently recomputed by run_p1_selection.py

score.definition: S(q,x) = FP32 log-softmax sum of response+EOS token log-probs given prefix(query); mean is a length diagnostic only; corrected = S(q,x)-S(empty,x) is a known candidate-prior correction diagnostic, not a new method

budget.note: first of the three reached stops the run; current gate 1 authorizes 0 card-hours and 0 scored pairs (implementation + CPU selection only)

notes: P1 instrument check on official paired data: exact-UID pairing sanity only, NOT semantic retrieval R@K. Selection fixed before any model score; scores never used for selection. Gate 2 (NPU run) requires Codex pilot_authorized with the reviewed full SHA.
